title: Bram and the Vow
author: Lena Eriksen
blurb: Vesper Thackeray, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
